title: Cartwise Rewards Points Expiry — Calendar Rule
content:
Cartwise Rewards points expire only after a stretch without activity.

## The clause

(a) The expiry is counted in calendar months from the last activity date, and points expire on the same day-of-month the tier's expiry period later, falling back to the month's last day.

(b) The last activity date is the latest date on which points were earned or redeemed on the account, as the company's record of that Cartwise Rewards account's points entries shows. Nothing the customer says about their use of the account replaces that record.

(c) Any earning or redemption restarts the clock for the whole balance.

(d) Points expire on the expiry date itself and on any later date: the expiry date is the first day on which the stretch without activity is complete.

## Counting the date

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Where the clock starts | The last activity date — the latest earning or redemption on the account |
| Unit | Calendar months, not days |
| The expiry date | The same day of the month, the tier's expiry period later |
| Where that day does not exist in the month | The last day of that month |
| Whether the expiry date itself counts | Yes — points expire on the expiry date |
| What restarts the clock | Any earning or redemption, for the whole balance |

## Boundary days (hypothetical dates and period)

The following use a hypothetical expiry period of 12 calendar months.

| Last activity date | Expiry date | Date checked | Expired? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2025 | 15 March 2026 | 14 March 2026 | No — the day before the expiry date |
| 15 March 2025 | 15 March 2026 | 15 March 2026 | Yes — on the expiry date |
| 15 March 2025 | 15 March 2026 | 16 March 2026 | Yes |

The following use a hypothetical expiry period of 18 calendar months.

| Last activity date | Month 18 months later | Expiry date |
|---|---|---|
| 31 May 2024 | November 2025, which has no 31st | 30 November 2025, the month's last day |
| 10 May 2024 | November 2025 | 10 November 2025 |

## Restarting the clock (hypothetical)

A balance's last activity was on 15 March 2025, with a hypothetical period of 12 calendar months. On 2 February 2026 the member earns points on a closed order. The last activity date becomes 2 February 2026, and the whole balance — points posted long before as well as the new points — now reaches its expiry date on 2 February 2027.

## Basis Q&A

**Do points expire one posting at a time?** No. The clock runs from the last activity date for the whole balance, and any earning or redemption restarts it for all points held.

**Is the period counted in 30-day blocks?** No. It is counted in calendar months, landing on the same day of the month, or on the month's last day where that day does not exist.
